verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.stripe.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with agent-directed instructions. Treasury docs are also served as Markdown: treasury.md returns 200, and many Treasury doc URLs use the .md form. An agent can therefore be pointed at agent-oriented docs for this product. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/Markdown docs offering, and confirmation that llms.txt specifically indexes the Treasury section.
